read_problems: Header is "Number of Rooms/Baths" (e.g. "2/1"); treated first number as rooms (not beds, left as -) and second number as baths per instructions not to derive bedrooms from room count.
8F tax_m (carry_m $1,026.49) column value possibly $8.28 matches but RMU payment cell for 8F appears blank in source image.
"Number of Rooms/Baths" column gives combined rooms/baths (e.g. "4/2"), not separate beds/baths; placed as-is in beds column, baths left blank since bedroom count cannot be derived from rooms.
T/B* column (2T/B) appears to indicate Terrace/Balcony type, not bath count; beds/baths taken from "Number of Rooms/Baths" column (e.g. 6/2.5 = 6 rooms/2.5 baths).
